name: Smith
bio: Items under the bare name Smith refer to different men: Superintendent Smith of the stage road, who came in from the line in March 1885 and lost his post that April, deputy marshal Smith of Miles City, who arrested Win Roberts in May 1885, and a Smith of Germantown, Pennsylvania, visiting Howard Eaton's ranch in March 1886.

moments.label: Stage road superintendent came in from the line

mentions: Superintendent Smith, of the stage road, came in from the line Wednesday.

Again has the decapitator been at work and the heads of Gen'l. M'n'g'r. Simpson and Superintendent Smith fall into the basket. We are sorry to see Mr. Smith go as he was a good stage man and agreeable gentleman. It would have been a sin, however, to keep Simpson, as the Dak…
Win Roberts was arrested last week below Rapid City, in the Hills, by deputy marshal Smith, of Miles City. He was taken through here Sunday night. It is supposed that the charge is horse-stealing.
Messrs. Thomas and Smith of Germantown, Pa., are visiting in the Bad Lands. They are now at Howard Eaton's ranch, where they will spend a week or two.
